summary: Frontend-only regression of Fox dashboard quick-entry flows completed on desktop and 390px mobile. Shortcuts, modal forms, third-party person linking, card installments, investment modal, close behavior, mock-only submit behavior, and mobile overflow passed; recurrence is missing from expense and income.

integration_issues.issue: The requested recurrence field/control is absent from both forms.

action_items: Add a recurrence control to expense and income forms, with the requested recurrence options, while keeping the values MOCKED/local-only.
Re-run the quick-entry regression after adding recurrence controls.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickEntryModal conditionally renders card recurrence only; expense and income have no recurrence state or field despite the product requirement.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Fabiane and local person tests used frontend MOCKS only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://fox-ui-core.preview.emergentagent.com tested. All four shortcuts opened and closed. Expense required controls, income equivalent controls, Terceiros→Fabiane and local person linking, payable relationship, card debit/credit plus 5x/custom installments, investment controls, no horizontal overflow, and no API/Supabase write on submit passed. Recurrence selectors were absent for expense and income.
rca of the issue: QuickEntryModal.jsx defines no recurrence state or field for expense/income. The only recurrence JSX is guarded by isCard, so the rendered forms cannot capture recurrence for the two required transaction types.
